lines.text: Pioneers of Peri Peri chicken in Antigua

c118277296.notes: Black roadside board in front of the restaurant on Dockyard Drive, English Harbour (camera 17.0122, -61.7686); a support post crosses the S of FLATTIES. 'GRILL' is in a flame-style font between two spatula icons. The yellow 'Carib REAL CARIBBEAN BEER' logo at the right end is advertising, not part of the label. Distractors: a second identical board at far right, 'JACKEE'S' sign on the white building, menu chalkboards and a 'Welcome to Jackee's...' easel.

c139760965.notes: Hanging white sign on a metal frame at the gate of a mosque in St. John's (camera 17.1132, -61.8292), seen from a distance and slightly from below; red arrow under 'Masjid' points left. At left is a decorative Arabic calligraphy logo (محمد, Muhammad) with tiny honorific text; it is not transcribed. Parked cars behind (number plates incidental and small).

c139761912.notes: Weathered concrete village welcome sign, Saint Mary Parish (camera 17.0508, -61.8084). Blue stencilled 'WELCOME TO' (arched) / 'JOHN HUGHES' / 'COMMUNITY', then four red-brown locality names in two columns, each preceded by a dot (left: FOLLY, SAWCOLTS; right: BISHOP, WALLINGS), listed row by row. Bottom line '(DONATED BY F.S.CONSTRUCTION)' is faded and stained (the T of CONSTRUCTION is worn) and is not transcribed. Mould and rust streaks over the paint.

c184150849.reason: heavily motion-blurred shot from a moving car; the bend warning sign and the red plate under it are unreadable

c184150852.notes: Green US-style street blade on a rusty perforated post in Codrington, Barbuda (camera 17.6372, -61.8265). The post hides the 'R' and most of the 'T' of AIRPORT (only a sliver of the T shows), so the legible text is 'AIRPO' + 'RD.'; the sign reads Airport Rd. Distractor: the faded cross blade above, 'EAST / AIRPORT LN.' (first letters worn off).
